parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that determines the start point of the next query. If this parameter is empty, no additional results exist.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the Auto Scaling resources reside.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The Auto Scaling resource type. Set the value to scalinggroup, which indicates that the tagged object is a scaling group.
